info.title: LiquidLM API
info.description: LiquidLM REST API — the public surface callable with a Personal Access Token or CLI session. Every operation is tagged with its `x-liquidlm-action` and the lowest bundle that grants it (`x-liquidlm-min-bundle`). Session-only and app-internal endpoints are documented in the internal spec, not here.

bearerAuth.description: LiquidLM access token. Use `liquidlm login` for a CLI session JWT, `liquidlm token export --shell` for ad-hoc REST/curl testing, or a Personal Access Token in `$LIQUIDLM_API_TOKEN` for headless/CI.

opsKey.name: x-liquidlm-ops-key
opsKey.description: Static operational key (`LIQUIDLM_INTERNAL_OPS_KEY`), sent in the `x-liquidlm-ops-key` header or as a Bearer token. NOT a JWT/PAT and not gated by token scopes.

vault_ids.description: Omit/null for all visible vaults, [] for model-only baseline, or pass one or more readable vault IDs.

attachment_knowledge_ids.description: Knowledge IDs for already-uploaded attachments. Every ID must be readable in vault_ids; the server fetches them before the model answers.

validity.description: Temporal state of a knowledge node: whether it is live, not yet in effect, time-bounded, or expired. Absent on tag and entity nodes.

vault_id.description: Vault the knowledge node belongs to, so it can be opened in the vault browser.

superseded_by.description: Id of the knowledge node that supersedes this one.

media_start_sec.description: Start offset in seconds for transcribed audio/video; null when unavailable.

speakers.description: All assigned speaker IDs in this chunk, scoped to this recording. Not person names.

id.description: Client-generated UUID for idempotent note creation retries. Accepted only when `type` is `note`.

vault_id.description: Defaults to the caller's default vault.

content_date.description: Semantic date the content is about (ISO 8601). When set, the row is marked temporally overridden so indexing won't re-derive it.

truncated.description: The window held more rows than the limit. Rendering a range with days silently missing from it is worse than saying so.

connector_run_count.description: Connector syncs that ran against the scoped vaults that day — the answer to why a day holds hundreds of items.

reason.description: Why there is no summary. `generating` is worth waiting for; `unavailable` means no generator is configured here and waiting will not help.

updated_at.description: Last touch. The calendar takes the newest per day to mark stale days.

file_path.description: Storage path, for attribution in the result row.

mime_type.description: MIME type of the underlying file, where there is one. Distinguishes audio and video results, which both carry type 'file'.

types.description: Restrict to these knowledge types. Distinct from mime_type: notes and links have no file row, so a MIME filter cannot match them.

vault_ids.description: Restrict to these vaults. Omit for every readable vault; an empty set matches nothing rather than widening.

your_role.description: The calling user's role in this vault. Present so a vault row can show what you can do with it, including for people who cannot manage shares.

last_activity_at.description: When anything in the vault last changed, derived from the newest knowledge row. Null for an empty vault.

types.description: Filter by persisted knowledge.type. Vault uploads (including PNG/JPEG) are type=file (use filters.mime_type for image/*). type=image matches pipeline children (e.g. PDF pages, video frames) and explicit image-item rows.

vault_ids.description: Restrict to these vaults. Omit to search every vault the token can read; an empty list matches nothing.

pinned.description: true narrows the read to pinned items — the vault's standing context. This is the authoritative list; the pinned digest in the server instructions is a connect-time snapshot that can be stale. false is ignored rather than treated as the inverse.

x-liquidlm-mcp-tools.description: Mark a knowledge item as the vault's standing context, so agents see it before they search.
Write a note or link into a vault, indexed the same way an upload is.

type.description: file: utf-8 or base64 bytes (vault-style uploads; use file even when mime_type is image/*). image: explicit binary image row. link: URL-backed row. note: inline text body.

if_match.description: Copy updated_at from a fresh get_knowledge. Equivalent UTC/offset formats are accepted, preserving all six fractional digits. Conflicts return current_updated_at; re-read and merge before retrying.

x-liquidlm-mcp-tools.description: OpenAI-compatible search alias over the scoped LiquidLM knowledge search.
Hybrid semantic and full-text search across the vaults a token can read, returning ranked passages with citations.

rerank.description: false skips the optional LLM reranker for lower latency; hybrid retrieval still runs.

include_pinned.description: false omits the pinned-context sidecar. Default true.

vault_ids.description: Restrict to these vaults. Omit to search every vault the token can read; an empty list matches nothing.

pinned.description: true narrows the read to pinned items — the vault's standing context. This is the authoritative list; the pinned digest in the server instructions is a connect-time snapshot that can be stale. false is ignored rather than treated as the inverse.

include_expired.description: Phase E: surface rows past their valid_until in addition to valid rows. Default false. Use for forensic / historical queries; emits search.temporal_filter audit event.

include_pending.description: Phase E: surface rows whose valid_from is still in the future (pre-launch previews). Default false. Use for staging/preview queries; emits search.temporal_filter audit event.

x-liquidlm-mcp-tools.description: Remove a knowledge item from the vault's standing context, leaving the item itself untouched.
